title: Inverse limit on abelian-group towers is additive and left exact
statement: The inverse-limit functor from the category of inverse systems [def-weil-inverse-system] of abelian groups indexed by the natural numbers to abelian groups is additive and left exact [def-sp-left-exact-additive].

source.place: Tag 07KW, Lemma 15.88.1 setup for the inverse-limit functor

proof.text: For morphisms f and g of towers, the induced maps on the limit are equal after composing with every limit projection to a component, because each projection is additive. The limit hom extensionality lemma therefore proves that the map induced by f + g equals the sum of the induced maps.

source.document: Mathlib CategoryTheory limits and preadditive functors

proof.text: The limit functor is a right adjoint to the constant functor, so Mathlib provides an instance that it preserves all limits; this specializes to finite limits.

proof_origin.place: CategoryTheory.lim_preservesLimits and componentwise limit hom extensionality

split_report.summary: Completed the proof split without creating subordinate nodes. The first step identifies kernels of the inverse-limit map with inverse limits of levelwise kernels by an explicit compatible-tuple argument. The second step identifies finite biproducts and zero under inverse limit, proving additivity; combined with the first step and the definition of left exact additive functors, this proves left exactness.
